translations.literal: In a memorial he requested that wandering petitioners in all provinces be registered by relaying their native-place records and placed under baojia supervision. The emperor instructed: "What Huitian memorialized is quite correct—it is an excellent method for clearing litigation and suppressing banditry.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he asked that wandering petitioners in every province be registered through relay of their native-place records and placed under baojia supervision. The emperor replied: "What Huitian proposes is entirely sound. It is an excellent way to clear lawsuits and suppress banditry.

sentences.zh: 但此輩輾轉流徙，城市村落，所在皆有。

translations.literal: But these people wander and drift; they are found everywhere in cities and villages.
translations.idiomatic: But these people drift from place to place and are found in every town and village.

sentences.zh: 必一一收捕傳送，令原籍保甲監察，事理繁瑣，不若就所在地察禁。

translations.literal: To capture them one by one, transfer them, and have their native-place baojia keep watch would be tediously complex in procedure; it would be better to investigate and restrain them on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: To hunt them down one by one, send them back, and have their home districts' baojia keep watch would be endlessly cumbersome; it would be better to inspect and restrain them where they are found.

sentences.zh: 當令有司遇流匄強悍不法，即時捕治。

translations.literal: Officials should be directed: whenever wandering petitioners are violent and lawless, arrest and punish them immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials should be ordered: whenever wandering petitioners prove violent and lawless, they are to be arrested and punished at once."

sentences.zh: 」二十九年，以病乞休，上不允。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, citing illness, he requested retirement; the emperor did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 (1764), pleading illness, he asked to retire; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 再請，上命南還謁醫，不必解任。

translations.literal: When he asked again, the emperor ordered him south to seek medical care without having to resign his office.
translations.idiomatic: When he petitioned again, the emperor told him to return south for treatment without resigning his post.

sentences.zh: 九月，卒於途，諡文恭。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he died on the road; he was posthumously given the title Wengong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he died on the journey home and was posthumously titled Wengong.

sentences.zh: 明年，上南巡，幸無錫，賦詩猶及蕙田。

translations.literal: The next year, when the emperor toured the south and visited Wuxi, he composed a poem that still mentioned Huitian.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when the emperor toured the south and visited Wuxi, he wrote a poem that still spoke of Huitian.

sentences.zh: 蕙田通經能文章，尤精於三禮，撰五禮通考，首採經史，次及諸家傳說儒先所未能決者，疏通證明，使後儒有所折衷。

translations.literal: Huitian mastered the classics and could write well; he was especially expert in the Three Rites. He compiled the Comprehensive Study of the Five Rites, first drawing on canonical texts and historical records, then taking up disputed points among various schools that earlier Confucians had been unable to settle, clarifying and proving them so that later scholars would have a standard by which to weigh competing views.
translations.idiomatic: Huitian was thoroughly versed in the classics and a capable writer, especially in the Three Rites. His Comprehensive Study of the Five Rites first drew on canonical and historical sources, then worked through disputed points among later schools that earlier scholars had never settled, clarifying and proving them so that later readers would have a basis for judgment.

sentences.zh: 以樂律附吉禮，以天文曆法、方輿疆理附嘉禮。

translations.literal: He appended music and pitch regulations to auspicious rites, and appended astronomy, calendrical science, geography, and territorial administration to celebratory rites.
translations.idiomatic: He attached music and pitch regulation to the section on auspicious rites, and astronomy, calendrical science, geography, and territorial administration to the section on celebratory rites.

sentences.zh: 博大閎遠，條貫賅備。

translations.literal: The work is vast in scope and far-reaching in vision, systematically arranged and comprehensively complete.
translations.idiomatic: The work is broad and far-reaching, systematically arranged and comprehensively complete.

sentences.zh: 又好治易及音韻、律呂、算數之學，皆有著述。

translations.literal: He also delighted in studying the Book of Changes as well as phonology, pitch pipes, and mathematics—all fields in which he wrote.
translations.idiomatic: He also loved the Book of Changes, phonology, pitch pipes, and mathematics, and wrote on all of them.

sentences.zh: 子泰鈞，乾隆十九年進士，翰林院編修。

translations.literal: His son Taijun was a jinshi in the nineteenth year of Qianlong and served as a Compiler in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: His son Taijun passed the jinshi examination in Qianlong 19 (1754) and served as a Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 彭啟豐，字翰文，江南長洲人。

translations.literal: Peng Qifeng, courtesy name Hanwen, was a native of Changzhou in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Qifeng, styled Hanwen, was a native of Changzhou in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 祖定求，康熙十五年，會試、殿試皆第一，官至翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: His grandfather Dingqiu, in the fifteenth year of Kangxi, placed first in both the metropolitan and palace examinations and rose to Reader in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Dingqiu, in Kangxi 15 (1676), took first place in both the metropolitan and palace examinations and rose to reader in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 啟豐，雍正五年會試第一，殿試置一甲第三，世宗親拔第一。

translations.literal: Qifeng placed first in the metropolitan examination in the fifth year of Yongzheng; in the palace examination he was ranked third among the top tier, but the Yongzheng Emperor personally elevated him to first.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng placed first in the metropolitan examination in Yongzheng 5 (1727); in the palace examination he was ranked third among the top tier, but the Yongzheng Emperor personally raised him to first place.

sentences.zh: 授翰林院修撰，南書房行走。

translations.literal: He was appointed Academician Expositor in the Hanlin Academy and served in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Hanlin expositor and served in the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 三遷右庶子。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became Right Sub-Reader.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became right sub-reader.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六年，充江西鄉試副考官，再遷左僉都御史。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qianlong he served as associate examiner of the Jiangxi provincial examination and was again promoted to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 6 (1741) he served as associate examiner for the Jiangxi provincial examination and was promoted again to left assistant censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣驛路經宿州，宿州方被水，蒙恩賑恤。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "On my courier route I passed through Suzhou Prefecture. Suzhou had just suffered flooding and received imperial relief.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "On the courier route I passed through Suzhou Prefecture, which had just been flooded and was receiving imperial relief.

sentences.zh: 知州許朝棟任甲長胥吏索費，饑民戶籍登記不以實。

translations.literal: Prefect Xu Chaodong allowed headmen and clerks to extort fees; the household registers of famine victims were not recorded truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Xu Chaodong allowed neighborhood headmen and clerks to demand fees, and the household registers of famine victims were not recorded truthfully.

sentences.zh: 鳳陽知府梅毓健不親詣察覈。

translations.literal: Fengyang Prefect Mei Yujian did not go in person to inspect and verify.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyang prefect Mei Yujian did not go in person to inspect and verify the relief work.

sentences.zh: 」下兩江總督那蘇圖嚴察。

translations.literal: The case was referred to Liangjiang Governor-General Nasutu for strict investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to Liangjiang governor-general Nasutu for strict investigation.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷通政使，督浙江學政。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Commissioner of the Transmission Office and supervised Zhejiang educational administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 7 (1742) he was made commissioner of the Transmission Office and appointed Zhejiang education commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三遷刑部侍郎，疏言：「浙省吏民佔官湖為田，餘杭南湖發源天目，下注苕溪，溉杭、嘉、湖三郡。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became Vice Minister of Punishments and memorialized: "In Zhejiang officials and commoners have encroached on government lakes to farm them. South Lake in Yuhang rises from Mount Tianmu and flows down into Tiao Creek, irrigating the three prefectures of Hang, Jia, and Hu.
translations.idiomatic: After three more promotions he became vice minister of Punishments and memorialized: "In Zhejiang, officials and commoners have encroached on government lakes and turned them into fields. South Lake in Yuhang rises on Mount Tianmu and flows into Tiao Creek, watering the three prefectures of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 自巡撫朱軾濬治，今已沙淤。

translations.literal: Since Governor Zhu Shi dredged it, it has now silted up with sand.
translations.idiomatic: Since Governor Zhu Shi dredged it, it has silted up again.

sentences.zh: 其他會稽、餘姚、慈谿等湖，皆僅存其名，請敕次第開濬。

translations.literal: Other lakes at Kuaiji, Yuyao, Cixi, and elsewhere survive only in name. I request an imperial order to dredge them in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Other lakes at Kuaiji, Yuyao, Cixi, and elsewhere exist only in name. I ask that an imperial order be issued to dredge them in turn.

sentences.zh: 江南漕米，每石收錢五十四，半給運丁，半歸州縣為公使錢。

translations.literal: In Jiangnan, for each picul of tribute grain fifty-four cash are collected—half for transport laborers and half for the prefecture and county as public service funds.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangnan, fifty-four cash are collected for each picul of tribute grain—half for transport laborers and half for prefectural and county public-service funds.

sentences.zh: 杭、嘉、湖運丁有漕截，而州縣無漕費，石米私加一二升至五六升，請敕如江南例，石米收錢二十四，為州縣修倉鋪墊費，而禁其浮收。

translations.literal: In Hang, Jia, and Hu the transport laborers receive canal-haul subsidies, but the prefectures and counties have no canal fees, so privately one to two sheng—or as much as five or six sheng—are added per picul of rice. I request an imperial order that, following the Jiangnan precedent, twenty-four cash be collected per picul of rice for prefectural and county warehouse and paving expenses, and that excess collection be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou the transport laborers receive canal subsidies, but the prefectures and counties receive no canal fees, so officials privately add one or two sheng—and sometimes as much as five or six sheng—per picul of rice. I ask that, following the Jiangnan precedent, twenty-four cash be collected per picul for prefectural and county warehouse and paving expenses, and that unauthorized surcharges be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 浙江額設均平夫銀供差徭，差簡可以敷用，差繁每苦賠墊，本省官吏來往，任意多索，請敕部按官吏尊卑、差役繁簡，定人夫名額，俾為成例。

translations.literal: Zhejiang allocates equalization labor silver for corvée duties; when duties are light the funds suffice, but when they are heavy officials often suffer out-of-pocket losses. Officials traveling within the province arbitrarily demand more. I request the ministry set quotas for laborers according to official rank and the frequency of duties, to make a fixed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang sets aside equalization labor silver for corvée service; when duties are light the funds suffice, but when they are heavy officials often pay out of pocket. Officials traveling within the province demand extra labor at will. I ask the ministry to fix quotas of laborers according to rank and the frequency of assignments, and make that the standing rule.

sentences.zh: 浙省黃岩、太平地多斥鹵，民家稍有餘鹽，兵弁藉以婪索。

translations.literal: In Huangyan and Taiping of Zhejiang the land is largely saline; households with a little surplus salt are subject to extortion by military officers.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyan and Taiping the land is mostly saline; families with even a little surplus salt are prey to extortion by military officers.

sentences.zh: 婪索不遂，指為私鹽，甚或以數家數人之鹽合併誣報，請敕文武大臣申禁。

translations.literal: When extortion fails they denounce it as contraband salt, even combining salt from several households and people in false reports. I request that civil and military grandees be ordered to proclaim a strict ban.
translations.idiomatic: When extortion fails, they denounce the salt as contraband, even combining salt from several households and people in false reports. I ask that civil and military superiors be ordered to forbid this strictly.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and carried out his proposals.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and implemented his recommendations.

sentences.zh: 尋以憂去。

translations.literal: Soon he retired owing to bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 15 (1750) he was appointed vice minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十八年，調兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 (1753) he was transferred to vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二十年，疏乞養母，允之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized requesting leave to support his mother; his request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 (1755) he memorialized asking to retire and care for his mother; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，复授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was again appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 (1761) he was again appointed vice minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，以京察注考，吏部郎中阿敏爾圖諸尚書、侍郎皆列一等，啟豐獨列二等，上責其示異市名。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, during the capital inspection for performance ratings, Personnel Bureau Director Amin'ertu listed all the ministers and vice ministers as first grade; Qifeng alone was listed second grade. The emperor rebuked him for showing off and courting reputation.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 (1762), during the capital personnel review, Personnel Bureau director Amin'ertu rated all the ministers and vice ministers in the first grade; Qifeng alone was placed in the second. The emperor rebuked him for making a display and courting a reputation for integrity.

sentences.zh: 旋遷左都御史。

translations.literal: He was soon transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，遷兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was transferred to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 (1763) he was made minister of War.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，上以史奕昂為侍郎，入對，諭加意部事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the emperor appointed Shi Yi'ang as vice minister; when Yi'ang entered for audience, the emperor instructed him to pay special attention to ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 31 (1766) the emperor appointed Shi Yi'ang vice minister of War; when Yi'ang came in for audience, the emperor told him to give close attention to the ministry's business.

sentences.zh: 奕昂遂自恣，面斥啟豐，不稱尚書，侍郎期成額以是訐奕昂。

translations.literal: Yi'ang then grew arrogant, publicly rebuked Qifeng without using his ministerial title, and Vice Minister Qicheng'e impeached Yi'ang on this account.
translations.idiomatic: Yi'ang then grew insolent, openly berated Qifeng without addressing him by his ministerial title, and Vice Minister Qicheng'e impeached him for it.

sentences.zh: 上詰啟豐，啟豐力言無之。

translations.literal: The emperor questioned Qifeng; Qifeng emphatically denied it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor questioned Qifeng, who vigorously denied it.

sentences.zh: 詢侍郎鍾音，鍾音對如期成額。

translations.literal: When he questioned Vice Minister Zhongyin, Zhongyin answered as Qicheng'e had said.
translations.idiomatic: When he questioned Vice Minister Zhong Yin, Zhong Yin answered as Qicheng'e had.

sentences.zh: 啟豐語乃塞。

translations.literal: Qifeng had nothing more to say.
translations.idiomatic: Qifeng was left with nothing to say.

sentences.zh: 上為罷奕昂，因謂：「啟豐學問尚優，治事非所長。

translations.literal: The emperor dismissed Yi'ang, then said: "Qifeng's learning is still excellent, but administration is not his strength.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed Yi'ang and then said: "Qifeng's learning is still excellent, but he is not strong in practical administration.

sentences.zh: 今乃巽愞模棱，奏對不以實，失大臣體。

translations.literal: Yet now he is evasive and equivocal, answering memorial audiences without truthfulness—falling short of a grand minister's bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Now he has become evasive and equivocal, answering in audience without speaking plainly. That is unworthy of a grand minister."

sentences.zh: 」即降侍郎。

translations.literal: He was immediately demoted to vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately demoted to vice minister.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，命原品休致。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was ordered to retire at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 33 (1768) he was ordered to retire at his existing rank.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，上東巡，迎駕，予尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, when the emperor toured the east, Qifeng met the imperial procession and was granted the honorary title of minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 (1776), when the emperor toured the east, Qifeng came out to meet the imperial procession and was granted the honorary rank of minister.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，卒，年八十四。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he died, aged eighty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Qianlong 49 (1784), aged eighty-four.

sentences.zh: 子紹升，語在文苑傳。

translations.literal: His son Shaosheng is treated in the Biography of Literary Men.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shaosheng is discussed in the Biographies of Literary Men.

sentences.zh: 孫希濂，乾隆四十九年進士，官至刑部右侍郎，左遷福建按察使。

translations.literal: His grandson Xilian was a jinshi in the forty-ninth year of Qianlong, rose to Right Vice Minister of Punishments, and was demoted to Judicial Commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Xilian passed the jinshi examination in Qianlong 49 (1784), rose to right vice minister of Punishments, and was demoted to judicial commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 曾孫蘊章，自有傳。

translations.literal: His great-grandson Yunzhang has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Yunzhang has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 夢麟，字文子，西魯特氏，蒙古正白旗人，尚書憲德子。

translations.literal: Meng Lin, courtesy name Wenzi, of the Xilute clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, son of Minister Xiande.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Lin, styled Wenzi, of the Xilute clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner and the son of Minister Xiande.

sentences.zh: 進士，改庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: A jinshi, he was made a Bachelor of the Hanlin and appointed Proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: After taking his jinshi degree he entered the Hanlin as a bachelor and was appointed proofreader.

sentences.zh: 十五年，遷侍講學士，再遷祭酒，提督河南學政。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Reader of the Hanlin Academy, then again to Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, and supervised Henan educational administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 15 (1750) he was promoted to Hanlin reader, then to chancellor of the Imperial Academy, and was appointed Henan education commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 16 (1751) he was appointed grand secretary of the Inner Cabinet.

sentences.zh: 十七年，湖北羅田民據天堂寨謀亂，夢麟以河南商城鄰羅田，馳往捕治，上嘉之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the people of Luotian in Hubei seized Heaven's Terrace Fortress to plot rebellion. Meng Lin, noting that Shangcheng in Henan bordered Luotian, rushed there to capture and suppress them; the emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 (1752), the people of Luotian in Hubei seized Heaven's Terrace Fortress and plotted rebellion. Meng Lin, seeing that Shangcheng in Henan bordered Luotian, rushed there to suppress them, and the emperor praised his action.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「商城界江、楚，峻嶺深岩，易藏奸宄，請增兵巡察。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Shangcheng borders Jiang and Chu; its steep peaks and deep ravines easily conceal criminals. I request additional troops for patrol inspection.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Shangcheng lies on the border of Jiang and Chu; its steep ridges and deep ravines easily hide wrongdoers. I ask that troops be increased for patrol and inspection."

sentences.zh: 」下河南巡撫議，移駐守備，增兵百。

translations.literal: The Henan governor was ordered to deliberate; a garrison commander was relocated, and a hundred soldiers were added.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Henan governor for deliberation; a garrison commander was moved to the post, and a hundred troops were added.

sentences.zh: 十八年，署戶部侍郎，充江南鄉試考官，即命提督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he served as acting Vice Minister of Revenue, served as examiner of the Jiangnan provincial examination, and was immediately ordered to supervise Jiangsu educational administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 (1753) he served as acting vice minister of Revenue, examined the Jiangnan provincial examination, and was immediately appointed Jiangsu education commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十年，授工部侍郎，代還，調署兵部，兼鑲白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Works; when his replacement returned he was transferred to acting Vice Minister of War and concurrently served as Deputy Commander of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 (1755) he was appointed vice minister of Works; when his successor arrived he was transferred to acting vice minister of War and concurrently made deputy commander of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命在軍機處學習行走。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to serve in the Grand Council as a "learning attendant."
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 21 (1756) he was ordered to serve in the Grand Council as a "learning attendant."

sentences.zh: 大臣在軍機處，資望少淺者曰「學習行走」，自夢麟始。

translations.literal: Grand ministers with less senior standing in the Grand Council were called "learning attendants"; this began with Meng Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillors of relatively junior standing were called "learning attendants"—a usage that began with Meng Lin.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河決孫家集。

translations.literal: That year the Yellow River broke at Sunjiaji.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow River burst at Sunjiaji.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，河道總督白鍾山奏請開荊山橋河，命夢麟馳勘，趣即興工，工竟，議敘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Grand Canal Director Bai Zhongshan memorialized requesting the Jingshan Bridge River be opened. Meng Lin was ordered to rush to survey it, urged to commence work immediately; when the work was finished, merits were deliberated for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 (1757), Grand Canal director Bai Zhongshan memorialized to open the Jingshan Bridge River. Meng Lin was ordered to hurry there to survey the site and begin work at once; when the project was finished, rewards were deliberated.

sentences.zh: 上南巡閱河，以六塘河以下積潦，桃源、宿遷、清河諸縣卑成浸，令夢麟勘治。

translations.literal: When the emperor toured the south to inspect the waterways, from the Liutang River downstream stagnant floods had left Taoyuan, Suqian, Qinghe, and other counties low-lying and inundated; he ordered Meng Lin to survey and remedy the situation.
translations.idiomatic: During the emperor's southern tour to inspect the rivers, stagnant floodwater below the Liutang River had left Taoyuan, Suqian, Qinghe, and other counties submerged in low-lying land; Meng Lin was ordered to survey and repair the damage.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「六塘河上承駱馬湖，至清河分兩派，由武障、義澤等河匯潮河入海，長三百餘裡，中間淤淺數十處，已令速疏濬南北兩堰。

translations.literal: He soon memorialized: "The Liutang River rises from Luoma Lake; at Qinghe it divides into two branches and joins the Chaohu River via the Wuzhang, Yize, and other waterways to reach the sea, stretching more than three hundred li. Dozens of stretches in between have silted shallow; orders have been issued to dredge quickly the north and south embankments.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported: "The Liutang River rises from Luoma Lake; at Qinghe it splits into two branches and, through the Wuzhang, Yize, and other channels, joins the Chaohu River and reaches the sea—a course of more than three hundred li. Dozens of stretches along it have silted shallow, and orders have already been issued to dredge the northern and southern embankments at speed.

sentences.zh: 並去年水壞宿遷堰工，及諸缺口，俱加修築。

translations.literal: Last year's flood damage to the Suqian embankment works and various breaches were all reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: Flood damage last year to the Suqian embankment works and to various breaches has all been repaired.

sentences.zh: 諸縣積水，開溝十五，設涵洞五，建閘四，俾得宣洩。

translations.literal: For standing water in the counties, fifteen ditches were opened, five culverts installed, and four sluice gates built to allow drainage.
translations.idiomatic: To drain standing water in the affected counties, fifteen channels were opened, five culverts installed, and four sluice gates built.

sentences.zh: 」工既竟，又奏：「荊山橋河道經銅、沛、邳、睢四州縣，分設四汛；

translations.literal: When that work was completed, he again memorialized: "The Jingshan Bridge River course runs through Tong, Pei, Pi, and Sui—four prefectures and counties—and should be divided into four garrison zones;
translations.idiomatic: When that work was finished, he memorialized again: "The Jingshan Bridge River runs through the four districts of Tong, Pei, Pi, and Sui, and should be divided into four garrison zones;

sentences.zh: 黃水自丁家樓匯入蘇家閘，荊山橋正當其衝，應令堵築。

translations.literal: Yellow River water converges at the Su Family Sluice from Dingjialou; Jingshan Bridge lies directly in its path and should be blocked and built up.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow River water gathers at the Su Family Sluice from Dingjialou, and Jingshan Bridge lies directly in its path and should be blocked and reinforced.

sentences.zh: 微山湖至荊山橋河下游王母山，紆長灣曲，每歲霜降後應令疏濬。

translations.literal: From Weishan Lake to Wangmu Mountain downstream of the Jingshan Bridge River the course is winding and convoluted; dredging should be ordered each year after the Frost Descent.
translations.idiomatic: From Weishan Lake to Wangmu Mountain downstream of the Jingshan Bridge River the channel is long and winding; dredging should be ordered every year after the Frost Descent.

sentences.zh: 居民就灣築堰壩捕魚，渡口疊石為步，皆阻河道，應令嚴禁。

translations.literal: Residents build weirs and dams in the bends to fish, and at ferry crossings stack stones for steps—all obstructing the watercourse; strict prohibition should be ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Residents build weirs and dams in the bends to catch fish, and at ferry crossings stack stones into steps—all of which block the channel and should be strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」上命如所議行。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered implementation as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that his proposals be carried out.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫鶴年奏金鄉、魚台、濟寧諸州縣水患，命侍郎裘曰修偕夢麟馳往相度，合疏言：「諸縣久為微山湖水所浸，當籌分洩之路。

translations.literal: Shandong Governor Hexing reported on flood disasters in Jinxiang, Yutai, Jining, and other prefectures and counties. Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Meng Lin were ordered to rush there to survey. They jointly memorialized: "These counties have long been inundated by Weishan Lake water; routes for diverting discharge must be planned.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong governor Hexing reported flooding in Jinxiang, Yutai, Jining, and other districts. Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Meng Lin were ordered to hurry there and survey the ground. They jointly memorialized: "These counties have long been flooded by Weishan Lake water, and channels for diverting the overflow must be planned.

sentences.zh: 韓莊閘南伊家河至江南梁旺城入運，今已久淤，當開濬引積水東注。

translations.literal: South of Hanzhuang Sluice, the Yi Family River runs to Liangwangcheng in Jiangnan and enters the Grand Canal; it has long silted up and should be dredged to channel standing water eastward.
translations.idiomatic: South of Hanzhuang Sluice, the Yi Family River runs to Liangwangcheng in Jiangnan and enters the Grand Canal; it has long been silted up and should be dredged to carry the standing water eastward.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督尹繼善以沂水入運為害，奏建湖口閘，命夢麟與在工諸臣分任其責。

translations.literal: Liangjiang Governor-General Yin Jishan reported harm from the Yi River entering the Grand Canal and memorialized to build a Hukou Sluice. Meng Lin and the officials at the works were ordered to divide responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Liangjiang governor-general Yin Jishan reported that the Yi River's entry into the Grand Canal was causing damage and memorialized to build a Hukou Sluice. Meng Lin and the officials on the project were ordered to divide the work among themselves.

sentences.zh: 合疏言：「沂水自盧口傍洩，淹民田，阻運河。

translations.literal: They jointly memorialized: "The Yi River leaks aside at Lukou, flooding farmland and obstructing the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly reported: "The Yi River escapes sideways at Lukou, flooding farmland and blocking the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 當築壩堵截，使不得入運，毋礙微山諸湖入河歸海之路。

translations.literal: An embankment should be built to block it so it cannot enter the canal, without impeding the route by which lakes around Weishan enter the river and reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: An embankment should be built to cut it off so that it cannot enter the canal, without obstructing the path by which the Weishan lakes discharge into the river and reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 六塘河在駱馬湖下游，為沂水疏泄要道，宿遷、桃源諸水自沭入漣歸海，並宜疏治宣通。

translations.literal: The Liutang River lies downstream of Luoma Lake and is a key channel for relieving the Yi River; waters from Suqian, Taoyuan, and elsewhere flowing from the Shu into the Lian to reach the sea should all be dredged and opened.
translations.idiomatic: The Liutang River lies downstream of Luoma Lake and is the main outlet for the Yi River; the waters of Suqian, Taoyuan, and other places that flow from the Shu into the Lian and then to the sea should all be dredged and opened.

sentences.zh: 兼濬六塘河出口，使無淺阻。

translations.literal: The Liutang River's outlet should also be dredged so there is no shallow obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The mouth of the Liutang River should also be dredged so that it is not blocked by shallows.

sentences.zh: 此治沂水之概要也。

translations.literal: This is the outline for managing the Yi River.
translations.idiomatic: This is the general plan for managing the Yi River.

sentences.zh: 夏邑、永城諸水，自睢河下注洪澤湖，出清口會黃入海。

translations.literal: Waters from Xiayi, Yongcheng, and elsewhere descend via the Sui River into Hongze Lake, exit at Qingkou to join the Yellow River and reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The waters of Xiayi, Yongcheng, and other places descend through the Sui River into Hongze Lake, leave by Qingkou to join the Yellow River, and reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 近歲河道多淤，董家溝諸地尤宜急治，兼濬洪澤湖出口。

translations.literal: In recent years many river channels have silted; places such as Dongjiagou especially need urgent repair, and Hongze Lake's outlet should also be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years many channels have silted up; Dongjiagou and other places need urgent repair, and Hongze Lake's outlet should also be dredged.

sentences.zh: 清口束水二壩，遵旨撤除。

translations.literal: The two Qingkou embankments that constricted water were removed per imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: The two Qingkou embankments that had constricted the water were removed by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 各閘口門亦宜加寬。

translations.literal: The gates at each sluice should also be widened.
translations.idiomatic: The gate openings at each sluice should also be widened.

sentences.zh: 此治睢河之概要也。

translations.literal: This is the outline for managing the Sui River.
translations.idiomatic: This is the general plan for managing the Sui River.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，上許為頗得要領。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor approved it as having grasped the essentials quite well.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor approved it, saying it had grasped the essentials rather well.

sentences.zh: 調戶部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 冬，工竟，還京師。

translations.literal: In winter the work was finished and he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the work was completed and he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，復調工部，署翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was again transferred to the Ministry of Works and concurrently served as acting Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 (1758) he was transferred again to the Ministry of Works and concurrently served as acting chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 卒，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: He died and was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was granted state funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 論曰：照絀於盤錯，而優於詞翰，高宗知之審矣。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Zhao came up short amid knotty affairs, yet excelled in literary composition—the Gaozong knew this well indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: Zhang Zhao faltered when affairs were tangled as knotted roots, yet excelled in literary craft—the Qianlong Emperor knew that perfectly well.

sentences.zh: 汝來以清節著，惪華等以文學庸，而安國博辨群書，好學深思，自為家法。

translations.literal: Rulai was known for pure integrity; Dehua and others were employed for their literary learning; and Anguo was broadly versed in many books, fond of learning and deep thought, establishing his own family tradition.
translations.idiomatic: Gan Rulai was noted for upright integrity; Chen Dehua and others were valued for literary talent; and Wang Anguo was broadly learned, loved study and deep reflection, and formed a scholarly tradition of his own.

sentences.zh: 蕙田治禮，綜歷代政事學術，貫串會通，體大思精，尤彬彬名世之大業也。

translations.literal: Huitian's work on ritual integrated the administrative affairs and scholarly learning of successive dynasties, threading them together in synthesis—grand in scope and refined in thought—truly a great enterprise distinguished enough to mark an age.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Huitian's work on ritual gathered the administrative and scholarly learning of successive dynasties into one coherent whole—grand in design and refined in thought—truly a great achievement worthy to stand among the foremost scholars of the age.

sentences.zh: 夢麟早歲負清望，參大政，方駕遽稅，惜哉！

translations.literal: Meng Lin in his early years bore a reputation for integrity and took part in great affairs of state, yet his chariot axle broke suddenly—all too regrettable!
translations.idiomatic: Meng Lin in his early years enjoyed a reputation for integrity and had a hand in great affairs of state, yet death cut him down just as his career was gathering speed—what a pity!
